ranges.description: Wolhwa is a woman with fair, smooth skin and a fist-sized small face with delicate, neat features and large, clear eyes. She has a slender figure, pretty eyebrows and a characteristic smiling, crinkling-eyed expression, and her striking beauty is alluring. She wears flamboyant, gorgeous attire, like an elegant peacock.
